items.english: I would like to improve my pronunciation
Can you explain what that word means?
I have never been here before
This is my first time visiting Zambia
I grew up in England, but my family is from Zambia
I would like to learn more about Zambian culture
I find it easier to understand than to speak
Sometimes I forget the words I have learned
I am trying to practise every day
Please correct me if I make a mistake

source.doc: Peace Corps/Zambia PST 1995 Special Lessons: Nyanja

items.sourceEnglish: Please correct me if I say something wrong

items.english: I understand what you are saying
I am not sure how to explain it
Yesterday I went to the market with my family
When I was younger, I used to play football every day
Last year I visited my grandparents
I have always wanted to learn another language
When I arrived, everyone was waiting for me
I was tired because I had been working all day
We spent the afternoon talking and eating together
I remember visiting this place when I was a child
That was one of the best days of my life
I hope I can visit again next year
I believe learning languages is important
In my opinion, this is the best option
I understand your point, but I disagree
There are several reasons why I think this
I would prefer to do something different
I think we should discuss this first
I am not completely sure about that
If I have enough money, I will travel next month
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home
I would have come earlier, but I was working
Even though I was tired, I decided to continue
I need to find somewhere to stay for the night
Could you recommend a good place to eat?
I would appreciate it if you could help me
Please let me know when you arrive safely
I have been waiting here for almost an hour
I will contact you as soon as I have more information
I wish I had started learning Nyanja earlier
I am looking forward to meeting your family
I would like to know more about the local traditions
Thank you for taking the time to explain everything
I hope we can speak again sometime soon
